history.p: Throughout his entire life Gade was fascinated by the the biblical story of Judith. As early as the winter 1847 he asked the German poet C. Schultes to write an opera text for him, the latter having proposed Judith. Gade was delighted and decided to compose the music, but after having returned to Copenhagen in the spring of 1848 he abandoned the project. Then in 1859 Gade was once more working on a new Judith text, this time by Adolph Hertz who was well known as a translator of opera texts. He was confident that he would be able to finish the opera in time for performance during the season 1859-60, but for unknown reasons, this opera project was also abandoned.
